description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility are not segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized modification or misuse.
applicability: Applies when an organization allows individuals to perform conflicting duties such as development and production deployment, financial approval and payment execution, or security configuration and security auditing without compensating controls.

metadata.detection_notes: Analyze role assignments for conflicting duties, review access control matrices for separation violations, assess financial and technical approval workflows, verify compensating controls where segregation is not feasible.
